votes.motion: Enter into Closed Session for the purposes of discussing information provided to the public body during the procurement process under Title 63G, Chapter 6a, Utah Procurement Code
votes.description: The Council voted to enter a closed session to review or discuss procurement-related information that may not be publicly disclosed under the Utah Procurement Code, as needed to fulfill the Council's role in the procurement process.
The Council voted to conclude the closed session and adjourn the work session meeting.
